translate.label: Translate

draw.label: Draw

explain-selection.label: Explain selection
explain-selection.hint: Describe the selected area, text or markup in plain language, with dimensions when a measuring scale is set

compare-sheets.label: Compare sheets
compare-sheets.hint: Name and mark what was added, removed or moved compared with another page

measure.label: Measure this
measure.hint: Measure the selected shape or a described element and report it in the drawing's scale

take-off.label: Take off
take-off.hint: Count or measure elements of one kind and place the result as a schedule on the sheet

check-scale.label: Check the scale
check-scale.hint: Find the scale from the title block or a known dimension and set it

review-sheet.label: Review sheet
review-sheet.hint: Add clouds with numbered comments for the points a checker would raise

stamp-date.label: Stamp and date

clean-up.label: Tidy markups
